{"diagnosis":"Since the 2026-01-15 rollout, the v2 collector emits txn_ts in UTC while legacy emits America/Chicago local time, and silver_transactions mixes the two. v2 evening transactions land at 00:00-06:00 on the next UTC date, which produces the odd-hours alerts and the 31-row 2026-01-19 partition. Converting v2 timestamps to Chicago local time (UTC-6, since all data is in January with no DST) restores one consistent timeline and the correct txn_date.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.88,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS
SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id,
       customer_id,
       CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id,
       CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount,
       CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts,
       CAST(CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS DATE) AS txn_date
FROM raw_transactions
WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
